en.title: Request Redirection
en.description:
Assign requests to servers that can serve them. The final load of each server must be strictly less than max_req. Minimize the maximum cross-server distance.

This site's standard input/output format and supplementary bounds are as described in this problem.
en.input: The first line contains n (1≤n≤10^5), the second line requests[n], and the third line max_req[n]; all values are non-negative/positive integers ≤10^9. Server positions follow the array indices.
en.output: Output the minimum possible maximum redirection distance; output -1 if the total capacity is insufficient.
en.explanation: Binary search on the maximum distance. For a fixed distance, source and receiving servers form an interval bipartite graph; greedily match the leftmost remaining request with the leftmost remaining capacity by position, and fail if they are too far apart. The small-scale oracle enumerates the destination of every request.
